reasoning: A graph on 14 vertices with girth at least 7 cannot have any vertex of degree 3 or higher. From any degree-3 vertex, the radius-3 neighborhood in a girth >=7 graph must form a tree with 1+3+6+12=22 vertices, exceeding 14. Thus all degrees <=2, so the graph is a disjoint union of paths and cycles (>=7). This implies at most 14 edges (a single C14 or smaller). Since 18>14 edges, at least some degrees >=3 is required (by handshaking lemma), which is impossible. Hence no such graph exists (3-colorability is irrelevant).
